_meta.purpose: Verified source of record for the portfolio's project copy. The site is rendered from static HTML (index.html) — this file is documentation, not build input.
_meta.method: README.md, package.json, source tree and live URL of each repository, read via the GitHub API; live pages captured with a headless browser.
_meta.rule: Only claims traceable to a listed source appear on the site. Unverifiable claims are omitted rather than softened.

featured.name: Koinelio
featured.status: In Progress — IIT Bhilai email-restricted pilot
featured.purpose: Supabase-backed campus community platform for profiles, approved clubs, student leadership, events, notifications and role-restricted club rooms.
features: Sign-up restricted to confirmed @iitbhilai.ac.in accounts; sign-up can only create student profiles
Persisted profile editing and avatar upload (JPG/PNG/WebP, up to 2 MB)
Posts, likes, comments, events, registrations, announcements, notifications
Club proposals, membership requests, invitations, Core Member assignment, governance approvals
Three club rooms (General, Members, Core Team) gated by Row Level Security
Post reporting with moderator-only resolution; recruitment and elections pages exist
featured.engineeringNote: Role privileges are granted only through database workflows, never from client-supplied sign-up metadata.
featured.limits: README describes production hardening in progress: access/governance migrations are not validated on staging and not applied to the live Supabase project; not an official IIT Bhilai service.

evidence.note: Public landing page only; signed-in app requires an account.

sources: supabase/migrations/ (14 migrations incl. RLS, storage, moderation)

featured.name: SmartNotepad
featured.purpose: Cloud note-taking app: write in a responsive editor and keep notes tied to a Supabase-authenticated account.
features: Next.js 15 App Router with React 19 interface
Cloud notes in Supabase with persistent per-user data
Supabase Auth sign-in, plus a demo workspace for exploring without an account
Typed codebase with ESLint and Prettier scripts
featured.limits: README calls it 'actively developed' and a personal productivity project. No collaboration, sharing or publishing features are claimed.

evidence.note: Sign-in screen; editor is behind authentication. The page's own copy says demo notes are not synced or saved.

featured.name: NextMarga
featured.purpose: Student platform for discovering scholarships, competitions, exams, internships, research programs and hackathons, with a profile, roadmap, application tracking and an AI career assistant.
features: Opportunity search and filtering with category browsing and deadline information
Student profile with education, interests, skills and goals, plus an onboarding wizard
Roadmap, applications and dossier screens
CareerAI chat and assessment endpoints behind a server API that validates requests before calling Gemini
Supabase auth and data with RLS; PWA support and a Capacitor Android project
featured.engineeringNote: AI calls sit behind a server boundary so keys never reach the client and payloads are validated before forwarding.
featured.limits: README calls it 'actively developed' and says opportunity coverage is still evolving. AI guidance is assistance; eligibility and deadlines should be checked against official sources.

evidence.note: Architecture diagram redrawn from the README. A live capture during review showed an empty opportunity list, so no screenshot is presented as a product preview.

sources: src/components/ (Profile, OpportunityHub, Roadmap, Applications, CareerAIChat, Assessment, Onboarding)

featured.name: ASRS — student record system
featured.purpose: Attendance and academic-records system for students, faculty and administrators, with a portal per role and Firestore rules behind it.
features: Role-based portals: profiles/{uid}.role of student, faculty or admin decides the portal
Firestore collections: profiles, courses, enrollments, attendanceSessions, attendanceRecords, marks
Firebase email/password auth with firestore.rules for role and ownership access
Documented deployment checks for auth, role routing and Firestore access
featured.limits: Published as a demo. Not described as an official IIT Bhilai system; no adoption, user numbers or endorsement claimed. README asks for authorised and unauthorised paths to be tested before any deployment is treated as ready.

evidence.note: Public landing page; portal dashboards require sign-in.
